practical: Demonstration of guided missile sub-assemblies in weapon demo room; Safety precautions regarding live weapon handling; Instructor supervision during handling.
intro_questions: What are the primary components of a guided missile?
Define the function of the propulsion unit in a missile.
List three types of warheads used in air craft armaments.

summary_questions: Explain how the guidance unit directs the missile to its target.
Describe the role of the control unit in stabilizing flight.
Identify the safety precautions required when handling warhead units.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on the basic principles of propulsion systems used in guided weapons to be discussed in the next lesson plan.

pft_rows.syllabus: The basic principle of propulsion system used in guided weapons, present day propulsive systems and propellants for rockets and their classifications. Practical on propulsion system.
